basic_details.short_information: Applications for 1 Project Technical Support–II post at AIIMS Gorakhpur must reach the institute by 25 October 2026 (they are accepted from 21 October 2026). Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed on 5 November 2026 at 10 AM in Room No 211, Second Floor, OPD Block, Department of Cardiology, AIIMS, Gorakhpur. All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Gorakhpur (Ref: AIIMS/GKP/Cardio OPD/2026/271, dated 12/10/2026) is filling the post on a purely temporary basis in an ICMR-funded extramural research project. The monthly emoluments are ₹20,000 + 20% HRA = ₹24,000.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Gorakhpur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Gorakhpur is an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India, in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. This post is in the ongoing ICMR-funded extramural research project "CARDINAL: A Pilot Study on Comprehensive AI-driven Risk Detection and Integrated analysis for Advanced cardiovascular care." The Principal Investigator is Dr. Ashutosh Prasad Tripathi, Assistant Professor, Department of Cardiology, AIIMS Gorakhpur.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is 1 vacancy for Project Technical Support–II. The notice says that the number of posts may vary. The upper age limit is 28 Years, counted as on the last date of application (25 October 2026). The notice prints the essential qualification and experience as: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject / field OR Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + two years' experience in relevant subject Experience is counted from the date you completed the minimum essential educational qualification. Meeting the essential qualification or experience does not guarantee shortlisting or selection. Experience in collecting and handling all types of samples including blood, urine and stool Processing and temporary storage of collected clinical samples for its derivatives Documentation of the records of receiving, storing, and retrieving of samples One year experience of working in a research institute/ university hospital Age relaxation will be as per ICMR guidelines. SC/ST/OBC candidates get age relaxation only for posts reserved for their category, not for an unreserved post, as per GoI rules. Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen and Departmental candidates, including those from projects, applies as per Govt. of India/ICMR Norms. Candidates already working in regular or permanent posts under government departments or organisations are not eligible to apply. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The pay includes 20% HRA. The notice says the rates of the emoluments or stipend may vary according to the sanction of the project's funding agency. Because the post is purely temporary, no provident fund, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim or similar benefits will be considered. Leave follows ICMR Guidelines. Engagement follows the guidelines of the project sanctioning agency. Successful candidates will normally be engaged on Project Human Resource Positions, initially for 6 months or less, depending on the tenure of the project and functional requirements. Continuation or extension depends on the performance evaluation, the tenure of the project, the availability of funds, functional requirements and approval from the competent authority. Staff will normally be posted at the study site but can be posted to any other site in the interest of research work. The competent authority will decide at its discretion which project the successful candidate is allotted to. This is NOT permanent employment with AIIMS Gorakhpur. Staff have no claim to a regular post in ICMR, AIIMS Gorakhpur or any other government organisation. Project service, with or without breaks, gives no right to absorption or regularisation. AIIMS Gorakhpur reserves the right to end the position even during the agreed contract period without giving any reason. The appointment can also be ended at any time, without notice or compensation, if the Principal Investigator finds the appointee's performance unsatisfactory. The selected candidate will have to join within 5 days of the declaration of results.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Use the application form in the prescribed format attached to the notice ("Application for engagement of Project Human Resource Position, purely on temporary basis"). Fill in every column in Block Capitals with a blue or black ballpoint pen. Write "N/A" where you have nothing to enter. Do not overwrite or use whitener. Write your name, mother's name, father's name and date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY) as they appear in your Matriculation Certificate. Also give your category, your present address with PIN code, your own mobile number and your own email address. Fill in your educational qualifications from 10th onwards and your work experience, both supported by documents. Also fill in your total experience after the minimum essential qualification, your research skills, your proficiency level in statistical software and the time you would need to join. Paste a latest passport size photograph. Then sign the declaration, put your thumb impression in the marked spaces and fill in the place and date. Send the completed form either by post to Room No 211, Second Floor, OPD Block, Department of Cardiology, AIIMS, Gorakhpur, or by email to [email protected] . Applications are accepted from 21 October 2026 and must reach by 25 October 2026. Late, delayed, incomplete or unsigned applications, and applications without a latest photograph, will be rejected without any correspondence. The institute is not responsible if an application is not submitted on time for any reason.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bring these documents in original to the interview. Items marked * also need one set of self-attested photocopies, submitted with the application form. The institute has no photocopy facility, so bring the photocopies with you. Filled application format Photo Identity proof (Aadhar card/ Driving Licence/ Voter ID card/ PAN card/Passport) * Address proof (Aadhar card/ Driving Licence/ Voter ID card/ PAN Card/ Passport) * Proof of date of birth (10th Certificate/ Birth certificate) * Recent passport size photographs (two) Relevant Marksheets and Certificates: 10th Marksheet & certificate, 12th Marksheet & certificate, Qualifying degree/ certificate * Experience certificate clearly showing date of joining and date of relieving * List of publications, along with one original copy (if any) * GATE/ NET clearance certificate (if any) * A detailed bio-data / CV, and proof of caste A "No Objection Certificate" from your employer, if you are already employed

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called. If there are many eligible candidates after scrutiny, the appointing authority may use suitable higher criteria to decide who is called for the interview. The interview is held in person at the venue on 5 November 2026 at 10 AM. There is no online interview, and requests to change the interview date will not be entertained. Shortlisted candidates submit a copy of the application form with a complete set of self-attested copies of their educational and experience certificates and photo identity. The originals are checked at the same time. Candidates found not suitable in the document verification will not be allowed to appear in the personal interview. Employed candidates who do not produce a No Objection Certificate will not be allowed to appear. The decision of the Interview Committee will be final. No TA/ DA will be paid for attending the interview, and candidates must arrange their own transport and accommodation.

content_sections.text: Giving incorrect or false information during the walk-in-interview or personal discussion will disqualify the candidate at any stage. Canvassing, or bringing any inside or outside influence for shortlisting or employment, will disqualify the candidate and bar them from the selection process. ICMR and/or AIIMS Gorakhpur may consider or reject any application or candidature, and may cancel or modify the process at any time. The institute is not committed to filling the advertised positions, and the process may be withdrawn, cancelled or modified at any time. faq.question: Q1. When is the AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Technical Support–II interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 5 November 2026 at 10 AM in Room No 211, Second Floor, OPD Block, Department of Cardiology, AIIMS, Gorakhpur. Only shortlisted candidates will be called.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted from 21 October 2026 and must reach by 25 October 2026. Applications received after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Technical Support–II. The notice says that the number of posts may vary.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Project Technical Support–II?
faq.answer: You need either 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject / field, or a Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + two years' experience in relevant subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 Years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation is as per ICMR guidelines. For SC/ST/OBC candidates it applies only to posts reserved for their category.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary, and is HRA paid on top of it?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated emoluments are ₹20,000 + 20% HRA = ₹24,000, so HRA is already included in the ₹24,000. No provident fund, Leave Travel Concession or Medical Claim benefits will be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the filled application form by post to Room No 211, Second Floor, OPD Block, Department of Cardiology, AIIMS, Gorakhpur, or by email to [email protected], so that it reaches by 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application format, photo identity proof, address proof, proof of date of birth and two passport size photographs. Also bring your 10th, 12th and qualifying degree marksheets and certificates and your experience certificates, in original with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. How is the selection made?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and shortlisted candidates are called for the interview. A document verification takes place first, and candidates found not suitable cannot appear in the personal interview. The Interview Committee's decision is final.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Technical Support–II job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely temporary, normally for 6 months or less at first, with any extension depending on performance, the project's tenure, funds and approval. It gives no claim to a regular post.
